identity.name: pre-cursa-o1
identity.summary: This is a merged language model created with mergekit.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card only states that the model is a mergekit TIES merge of two named 7B models and gives no design, training, or evaluation documentation, so the checkpoint itself lacks transparency about its development and inner workings.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not describe how the base or merged models' training data was collected, curated, or used, so training-data transparency is lacking for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card names the merged and base models but provides no information about the origin, ownership, or usage terms of the data used to train them, making data provenance uncertain.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: The card identifies the model only as a text-to-text merged language model and does not define intended uses, leaving the relevant risk profile unspecified.

specifications.model_size: 14.2 GiB of safetensors weights (15,225,551,792 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This model is a merge created with the TIES merge method, using marcuscedricridia/cursa-o1-7b as the base. The merged models are marcuscedricridia/absolute-o1-7b and marcuscedricridia/sbr-o1-7b.
